object_description: single building deployed along the slope, a central body flanked by two classroom wings over a buried gym
geometry_property: central body with two flanking bodies
wooden frame above ground on a concrete base
design_condition: the building follows the slope and exploits the natural unevenness of the land, its offset generating two distinct types of outdoor space, one public and one for the students, while maximising natural light

positive: The project respects and skilfully exploits the regulations on construction heights
It deploys the building along the slope, taking advantage of the natural unevenness of the land
It offers two types of outdoor space, one public and one for the students
The independent entrance to the after-school programme keeps it separate from the rest
This very clear system lets events with external extensions run without disrupting the school
The judicious position and offset of the volume obtain maximum space in natural light
The typology reads as a large central body with two flanking classroom bodies
Four classes per floor are grouped around a common space usable as an extension, study area or group work
The jury welcomes this device which offers a plus for teaching
The upper rooms benefit from overhead lighting in addition to side windows
The buried gymnastics room gets natural light through the generous entrance opening and a long slot
Its slanted wall should ensure constant and quality lighting
Burying the hall saves land for programmes not yet known
Gathering the whole first-stage programme in a single building is appreciable in bad weather and winter
Recycled reinforced concrete, a wooden frame and wooden box slabs are used
The identical tinted sheet metal on facades and roof guarantees energy efficiency and needs little maintenance
The jury recognises great typological foresight and respect for sustainable development principles
Leaving the western part free in the first stage allows open-air parking to be saved later
negative: The gymnastics room does not have straight views
